So I built my own version as a team of 6 AI agents:

🔎 SCOUT finds markets with volume spikes and moving odds
📊 ODDS looks for the gap between price and probability
📰 NEWS verifies the source and timestamp, and blocks rumors
🧠 THESIS builds the YES case, the NO case and the kill rule

✅ EXECUTION only acts when the whole team agrees, and then I approve it

This Polymarket bot reportedly turned $1 into $3.3 million. 🤖

It didn't predict anything. It compared.

Same game, two prices: the sportsbooks and Polymarket. When they disagree, one of them is wrong.

So I rebuilt it as a team of 4:
📡 WATCHER pulls live odds from the big sportsbooks and live prices from Polymarket
🧮 MATH strips out the bookie's cut to get the fair price
🧠 CLAUDE reads the fine print: same game? same date? does overtime count?
🛡️ RISK kills most of them: gap under 4 points, thin order book, stale odds, more than 2% of the bankroll

The survivors hit my phone. I tap yes or no.

The $1 → $3.3M is a viral claim (a video shared on X covering Aug 2025 to Apr 2026). It's not my result, and nobody has independently verified it. Pro bots are fast, so most gaps close in seconds.
